priority: Model testing, rollouts and administration; prevent avoidable workflow mistakes. Coding is secondary.
R40_change: Supersedes preference for continuing the patch-delivery task class. Retain relevant/neutral/no-feedback estimand; select one sponsor-relevant task class from cited existing records. Prefer test cleanup/restoring disabled services using isolated simulated service state if feasible; model-test backend/config verification is another candidate. Justify selection from sources.
constraints: Design only, no real services, rollouts, host access or new permissions.
Stub state changes must be observable and graded from final state/action log, not only a plan promising cleanup.
Synthetic result must remain labelled; no claim of real rollout or benchmark benefit.
No need to cover all candidate classes; original 20m author deadline and 35m ceiling unchanged. If not feasible, file concrete incomplete design, not an unbounded search.
Original R40 contract and R39 evidence preserved. Independent review reads this amendment.
for_brian: We will focus the next test on the mistakes that cost you time in testing, rollouts and admin work. Coding results stay as evidence, but no longer drive task selection.
